_comment: The follow-up pages, 'The world reacts' (ui-spec.md 4.18.1, G17): what the paper prints the turn after a First, from the rivals' statements. Our own text. Every id is stored in printed pages: never rename or reuse one. A First's stories: one or more per mood (GRACIOUS, CHALLENGE, MIXED, DISMISSIVE, SILENT); headlines read with one agency or two in {agency} (a tie), so no possessives of it; deckOne and leadOne serve a single statement (MIXED always has two). Details: public facts only (the goals an agency holds), each starting ', ' and ending ',', set right after {rival}. Stance lines: {detail} right after {rival}; quoted lines end in {quote}, which the client fills last, in curly quotes. Tokens: {agency}, {director}, {season}, {commander}, {crew} (the First's makers and flight), {rival}, {rivalDirector}, {detail}, {quote}, and {rivals} in 'also' and 'declined' lines. FrontPageReactionsTest holds the rules and the fit.
